# OCBASE/OCCT

> > Free, all-in-one stability testing, stress testing, benchmarking and PC monitoring tool for Windows and Linux systems.

OCBASE develops OCCT, a comprehensive hardware diagnostics and benchmarking platform used by gamers, professionals, and industrial manufacturers. The tool supports CPU, GPU, and memory stability testing with multiple editions ranging from free Personal to Enterprise+ with cloud diagnostics.

## Key Topics

- OCCT
- Stability Testing
- Stress Testing
- Benchmarking
- GPU Testing
- CPU Testing
- Memory Testing
- System Monitoring
- Hardware Diagnostics
- Overclocking
- Windows & Linux
- Enterprise Edition
- CSV Export
- RMA Diagnostics
- OCBASE CLOUD

## Getting Started

- [OCBASE/OCCT Homepage](https://ocbase.com): Main product page showcasing OCCT stability testing and benchmarking capabilities
- [Download OCCT](https://ocbase.com/download): Download OCCT for Windows and Linux with system requirements and licensing information
- [OCCT Product Overview](https://ocbase.com/occt): Comprehensive product overview covering CPU, GPU and memory stability testing features

## Product Editions

- [OCCT Personal Edition](https://ocbase.com/occt/personal): Free stability testing for CPU, GPU and memory with core monitoring features
- [OCCT Pro Edition](https://ocbase.com/occt/pro): Professional edition with CSV export, PNG reports and RMA diagnostic capabilities
- [OCCT Enterprise Edition](https://ocbase.com/occt/enterprise): Enterprise edition with test automation, GPU compute optimization and JSON reporting
- [OCCT Enterprise+ Edition](https://ocbase.com/occt/enterpriseplus): Advanced enterprise edition with OCBASE CLOUD, remote diagnostics and custom certificates
- [Pricing & Licensing](https://ocbase.com/purchase): Pricing and editions comparison for OCCT Professional and Enterprise licenses

## Use Cases

- [OCCT for Gamers](https://ocbase.com/useCase/gamers): Gaming optimization, overclocking validation and esports hardware stability testing
- [OCCT for Professionals](https://ocbase.com/useCase/pro): Pro Edition for prebuilt system validation, hardware diagnostics and RMA processes
- [OCCT for Industry](https://ocbase.com/useCase/industry): Industrial quality control and manufacturing automation testing applications
- [All Use Cases](https://ocbase.com/useCase): Overview of OCCT applications across gaming, professional and industrial sectors
